claude_proposed_widenings.name: cast_time_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The caster selects ONE of four mechanically distinct curse effects at cast time. The v4 taxonomy has 'choose' as a procedure atom but it is absent from types.ts. No existing ActivationPhase or EffectAtom variant can represent 'pick one of N alternative persistent effect packages at cast time' without lying about which effects are applied.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice: [list of 4 options]

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_scoped_roll_disadvantage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Option 1 applies disadvantage only to checks and saves made with a specific chosen ability. The current modify_roll_advantage carries a ReadonlyArray<RollKind> but no ability filter. A new variant or field (ability?: Ability) is needed to scope the roll modification to one ability's checks and saves.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: caster_relative_attack_scope
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Option 2 imposes disadvantage only on attack rolls directed at the caster, not all attack rolls. The current modify_roll_advantage has no scope or target restriction. A 'against_caster' scope variant is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeat_save_per_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Option 3 requires a saving throw at the start of each of the target's turns. The v4 taxonomy lists 'repeat_save' as a Resolution atom but it is absent from types.ts. This is a missing surface variant, not a new v4 atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: force_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Option 3's repeat-save failure forces the target to take the Dodge action. This is distinct from apply_condition (no standard condition makes a creature take Dodge) and from restrict_action_set (which removes choices, not mandates one). No v4 atom covers 'compel the target to spend its action on a specific StandardActionKind'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: slot_conditional_duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's duration and concentration status both change based on slot level: concentration 1 min (L3), concentration 10 min (L4), non-concentration 8 hr (L5-6), non-concentration 24 hr (L7-8), non-concentration until dispelled (L9). The current Duration type has no slot-conditional shape; concentration status changes with slot level cannot be represented.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you cast this spell using a level 4 spell slot, you can maintain Concentration on it for up to 10 minutes. If you use a level 5+ spell slot, the spell doesn't require Concentration...
